371:t_1:89.en:
$$勝平$$
「Him? Who cares about a guy like that!」

371:t_1:91.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$勝平$$ and $$ワッ太$$'s fight... looks like it's still going on.」

371:t_1:92.en:
$$マオ$$
「Leave them alone. They say even a dog won't touch that kind of quarrel.」

371:t_1:93.en:
$$宗介$$
「That applies to a married couple's quarrel.」

371:t_1:94.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh... That's a pretty classy expression for a guy like Sousuke to know.」

371:t_1:95.en:
$$甲児$$
「Well, considering how much people rag on him about $$かなめ$$, no wonder.」

371:t_1:97.en:
$$カイエン$$
(As for $$宗介$$, he seems to have sorted things out about $$かなめ$$.)

371:t_1:98.en:
$$シュレード$$
(The problem is him, I'd say.)

371:t_1:99.en:
$$甲児$$
「Anyway, when I hear the word volunteer, I can't keep quiet.」

371:t_1:100.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes... My blood's boiling for the first time in a long while.」

371:t_1:101.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Come on, $n. Our Club President $$アルト$$ went off to the $$残されの海$$, so the Vice President has to take command.」

371:t_1:102.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm counting on you, $n. Fire everybody up for us.」

371:t_1:103.en:
$n
「...Weren't we supposed to hold a re-election now that the term has changed...」

371:t_1:104.en:
$$宗介$$
「With the president, the manager and the advisor all gone, you're the only one we can count on.」

371:t_1:105.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If you like, I could take command. Me, the Master Sergeant.」

371:t_1:106.en:
$n
「Not a Master Sergeant but a Master Sweeper? Are you running for chief of cleanup?」

371:t_1:107.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Hey, you punk! Cracking lame puns like that!」

371:t_1:108.en:
$n
「I'm sorry, but I'll be the one protecting the Volunteer Club.」

371:t_1:109.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You're getting back into form.」

371:t_1:110.en:
$$ボス$$
「Damn right. Our Vice President's fighting spirit is the real deal!」

371:t_1:111.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Then we're counting on you, $n!」

371:t_1:112.en:
$n
「Vice President to all members! No matter where this is, our volunteer spirit doesn't change!」

371:t_1:113.en:
$n
「Those of you with your plastic bags and work gloves ready, start picking up trash!」

371:t_1:114.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So it's the same old thing after all!?」

371:t_1:115.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Give it up, $$ワッ太$$. Once $n announced taking command, it was a done deal that it would end up like this.」

371:t_1:116.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh... Looks like volunteering is beyond $$ワッ太$$, who cares more about his company's safe than the peace of Earth.」

371:t_1:117.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You said it, $$勝平$$! Don't underestimate my trash-picking power!」

371:t_1:118.en:
$$赤木$$
「All right...! Then let's have a contest, you two, to see who can collect more trash!」

371:t_1:119.en:
$n
「$$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$. You three are special Volunteer Club members today too. Work hard.」

371:t_1:121.en:
$$シンジ$$
($n... seems to have gotten over the shock of Miss $$スズネ$$ being kidnapped...)

371:t_1:122.en:
$$シンジ$$
($n is... strong... There's no way I could... do the same...)

371:t_1:123.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It's all right, $$シンジ$$. Just keep moving forward in your own way.」

371:t_1:124.en:
$$赤木$$
「$$カヲル$$'s right. Come on... you're a member of the Volunteer Club too, so let's get moving.」

371:t_1:125.en:
$$いぶき$$
「$$郁絵$$ and my $$谷川$$ and the others went to help with the soup kitchen, so lunch is something to look forward to.」

371:t_1:126.en:
$$青山$$
「If $$ミサト$$ were here, she'd say a beer after work is the best.」

371:t_1:128.en:
$$青山$$
(Mentioning $$ミサト$$ seems to have been a mistake...)

371:t_1:129.en:
$$赤木$$
(Looks like we'd better not touch on that subject.)

371:t_1:130.en:
$$カレン$$
「Hey, $$シンジ$$... What about $$アスカ$$, $$レイ#pt394$$ and $$マリ$$?」

371:t_1:132.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's the Volunteer Club's first activity in a long time, so you should've called out to them.」

371:t_1:137.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Come on, $$シンジ$$! Let's work with effort, guts and a spirit of service!」

371:t_1:138.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Look... Big Sis is quietly picking up trash too.」

371:t_1:139.en:
$$チコ$$
「Surprising... I never thought the $$姫$$ would take to this kind of thing so eagerly.」

371:t_1:140.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I can't stay quiet when I see Earth being polluted.」

371:t_1:141.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's my Big Sis! $$ノノ$$ is so moved!」

371:t_1:143.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Huh... So there are skylarks in a place like this. Must be because the mountains are close.」

371:t_1:145.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That's the name of the bird just now. I've told you before.」

371:t_1:146.en:
$$チコ$$
「Surprising again...! The $$姫$$ knowing so much about the names of birds!」

371:t_1:147.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Some time ago, on a mission, $$ノノ$$ saw a swan. After that she seemed to get interested in birds, and she keeps pestering me with questions.」

371:t_1:148.en:
$$チコ$$
「So that's how you got so knowledgeable.」

371:t_1:149.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're kind, $$ラルク$$. Looking up birds for $$ノノ$$'s sake.」

371:t_1:150.en:
$$ラルク$$
「N-No, it's nothing like that! I was just interested myself!」

371:t_1:152.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're wearing a creepy grin too, $$ノノ$$! If you want to set an example for $$シンジ$$, work briskly!」

371:t_1:153.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, ma'am! From this moment, $$ノノ$$ will give trash picking everything she's got!」

371:t_1:155.en:
$$カヲル$$
「This is nice, too. Things like this.」

371:t_1:161.en:
$n
(So I have to get back on my feet quickly... For everyone's sake, for Miss $$スズネ$$'s sake, and for my own.)

371:t_1:162.en:
$n
(When my spirits are down, I move my body... Now is the time to return to the basics.)

371:t_1:165.en:
$n
(Use no way as way, have no limitation as limitation...)

371:t_1:166.en:
???
「Amazing...! That dance just now was amazing...!」

371:t_1:169.en:
$n
「It's the name of the martial art I practice.」

371:t_1:171.en:
$n
「...Are you one of the kids from that camp?」

kept_omissions: 371:t_1:98: 彼 kept as 'him' (referent is either Hibiki/$n or Kappei; scene does not settle it)
371:t_1:96: まあな has no explicit object ('I suppose so' = Sousuke accepting Kouji's remark)
uncertain: 371:t_1:89: Kappei's 知るかよ read as 'who cares', answering Hanae's mention of Watta in the previous row
371:t_1:98: Shrade's 彼 - $n (Suzune's abduction, cf. rows 121-122) or Kappei; kept as 'him'
371:t_1:105/106: 曹長 / 掃除長 pun rendered as Master Sergeant / Master Sweeper (sound pun lost)
371:t_1:103: 期が変わった rendered 'the term has changed' (club officers re-election)
371:t_1:104: 部長/マネージャー/顧問 = president/manager/advisor; who the manager is is not stated
371:t_1:115: $n kept as name ('$n announced taking command') to avoid a gendered pronoun
371:t_1:125: chan honorifics on Ikue/Tanigawa dropped per style guide
371:t_1:142: Nono's 'What was that just now' presumably about the bird flushing; Lal'C answers about the skylark
371:t_1:165: rendered with Bruce Lee's published wording of the Jeet Kune Do maxim
371:t_1:171: 'kids from that camp' = refugee camp; kid is gender-neutral
